rationale: IT & Engineering Services ranks first because the PEO C3T opportunity is fundamentally a technical modernization effort requiring DevSecOps pipelines, software-defined radio integration, custom firmware and waveform delivery, and enterprise architecture work spanning WIN-T successor systems and ATAK-based mission command applications — all direct matches to this capability's sub-services including Agile & DevSecOps Adoption/Support, Infrastructure & Enterprise Architecture, and Commercial Software & Systems Integration. Cloud Computing ranks second given the explicit requirement for IL4/IL5 cloud environment experience, RMF authorization boundaries, and zero-trust cybersecurity architecture aligned with DoD Zero Trust Strategy, mapping closely to the Security, Operations & Management and Cloud Migration sub-services. Business Support Services earns the third position because the opportunity explicitly calls for Independent Verification and Validation of migrated network configurations and NATO STANAG interoperability testing, as well as training program development for Signal Corps soldiers and G6 staff — direct matches to this area's IV&V and Systems Documentation & Training sub-services. Data & Analytics was demoted below Management Consulting and Business Support Services because while situational awareness dashboards are mentioned, the opportunity's primary driver is network infrastructure integration and secure communications delivery rather than enterprise data governance or analytics pipeline work.
